components.summary: Runnable examples of executable models.
responsibilities: teach modeling by runnable examples

components.summary: Installs or checks the packaged skill and verifies portable public vocabulary.
responsibilities: install the packaged skill into a skills directory, or check an installed copy
side_effects: copies the skill files into the target skills directory

components.summary: Dispatches current-tree commands and reports progress toward one target.
responsibilities: parse commands and point removed flags at references/upgrade.md
show owners, closest owners, target changes, Mermaid and reviews in read
annotate planned target breakage and ARCH lines in check, change and release
run release with the system root counted and optional whole-suite shards
run bound tests and, on request, the checks an edit needs
write templates and their aliases into the active target when one exists
hint splits for large scan drafts and say when discovery finds nothing
side_effects: writes .flowguard/map.json on scan, deps --write and confirm

components.summary: Lazily exposes the core engine API from its owning modules.
responsibilities: expose public names from their owning modules on first use
point removed public names at references/upgrade.md

components.summary: Generates ordinary behaviour, validator and UI journey models plus adoption rules.
responsibilities: generate behaviour, validator and ui-journey starters plus six adoption rules
make placeholder code and test anchors fail until the user fills them
describe model and test outcomes in generated notes

components.summary: Collects exact pytest ids, runs bounded parallel shards and reports each test's outcome.
responsibilities: shard tests by exact node id and run every shard on each invocation
verify each collected test ran exactly once in the release whole-suite phase
report typed capability blockers and bounded process cleanup results
side_effects: runs pytest shards; writes run-local cache

components.summary: Inventories files, symbols, imports and duplicate bodies.
responsibilities: inventory files, symbols and imports, including literal import calls
handle a closed output pipe quietly for every command line entry
build a read-only inventory without creating or writing caches on request
parse bound-test item selectors as plain strings

components.summary: Owns map schema, component sub-systems, model bindings and direct component fingerprints.
responsibilities: load, validate and save the map, pointing a missing map at the guide
accept optional component parents and file-reading flow steps
merge the target overlay, validate its remove intents and compare it with current
compute component fingerprints that detect stale descriptions
register contract models from static literals and reject runner files
build the model tree and report nesting mistakes as errors
count import-like strings and injected attribute calls as dependency evidence

components.summary: Discovers entrypoints, effects and reachable calls.
responsibilities: discover entrypoints, side effects and state writers
resolve attribute calls through assigned or injected classes
count del statements as state writes and expose anchor state writes
discover without writing caches when asked
find the model anchors that code calls directly
build one static call graph from current or target source facts

components.summary: Checks ownership, reviews architecture and selects checks across explicitly protected component sub-systems.
responsibilities: check map anchors, files, flow steps and models against the code
report one owner per entrypoint, responsibility, state and side effect
lint cycles, layers, sizes and private names, then apply accepted debts
show the tree, Mermaid and digests with static facets and coverage
find owners by word form and rank architecture defects and strengths
compare current and target facets and list the rules a target changes
select the checks a change needs and list its unexplained functions
side_effects: reads git history; refreshes disposable analysis cache

components.summary: Holds one target and checks its design, the merged code and tests.
responsibilities: start, extend and drop one target at a time
check the merged tree: design mistakes are ERROR, missing code is TO-DO
mark only the breakage of a changed subject as moving to target
refuse a target that changes nothing, drops a promise or leaves it untied
promote a clean target and leave changed components draft
warn about earlier findings, stale debts and untested rules without blocking
list what to re-read after promotion and which files to delete
side_effects: writes current .flowguard/map.json and .flowguard/models/ only after a clean target check

components.summary: Runs model proofs, bound tests and the system root model.
responsibilities: run every model, system included, with known-bad and conformance checks
fail a model whose rule no known-bad variant breaks
report missing, placeholder or unconsulted anchors as model failures
give conformance a static code-facts reader
clean up model and pytest shard subprocesses in bounded time
run bound tests per item and require each to reach an anchor
print at most three open hazard hints per model
side_effects: runs one isolated pytest process per model when bound-test checking is requested

components.summary: Explores bounded state sequences and resumable checkpoints.
responsibilities: explore every bounded input sequence
check liveness and progress

components.summary: Provides reusable state invariants, trace contracts and scenario packs.
responsibilities: provide reusable invariants and trace contracts
derive hazard hints from the model's own structure and names
check that handoffs between child models close
close a hazard hint that a known-bad variant or invariant covers

components.summary: Checks named scenarios and minimizes counterexamples.
responsibilities: review scenarios against expected outcomes
minimise counterexamples

components.summary: Replays modeled traces and feature combinations against real implementations.
responsibilities: replay model traces on the code
build one model per allowed feature set, honouring requires and conflicts
collect projected child start states from parent traces
name feature-kit rules and known-bad from the feature list alone

components.summary: Benchmarks models against executable software problems.
responsibilities: benchmark the engine on a problem corpus

components.summary: Defines function blocks, workflows, traces and reports.
responsibilities: define function blocks, workflows and traces
compose a sequence of blocks or a choice of blocks by accepted input type

components.summary: UI journeys as a model kind: states, controls and transitions explored, checked against the UI source
responsibilities: check UI states, controls, displays and transitions, including recovery and dialog exits
compare declared controls and handler anchors with the UI source code

components.summary: Validators as a model kind: a finite input boundary, generated bad cases, each executed against the function.
responsibilities: generate every finite bad case and bounded interaction with stable ids and an oracle
reject invalid, unbounded or oversized boundaries instead of partial coverage
run every allowed bad-case combination on the checked function and name accepted ones
reject named bad cases with the default reject oracle
report a crash on a bad input as an error
